 Log in Dodgers acquire INF Royce Lewis from Twins (source)
 22 minutes ago MLB.com
 Share share-square--:R1qlq: The Dodgers have acquired infielder Royce Lewis from the Twins for right-hander Bobby Miller and 19-year-old Minor League catcher/first baseman Francisco Espinoza, a source told MLB.com's Mark Feinsand. 
 The clubs have not commented on the deal.
 Lewis, 27, has been beset by injuries in his five-year career. He played a career-high 125 games in 2026, hitting .227 with 15 homers, 57 RBIs and a .667 OPS.
